description: Track a custom event for a contact in Brevo (POST /events) — triggers Brevo automations. Required: event_name, identifiers ({ email_id } or { contact_id } / { ext_id }). Optional: contact_properties, event_properties, event_date.

contact_properties.description: Contact attributes to update with the event

event_name.description: Name of the custom event; can trigger Brevo automations

identifiers.description: Contact identifier: { email_id }, { contact_id } or { ext_id }

name: track_brevo_event
